title: South Africa single-site office / lab reference profile
purpose: Qualify the Luminous Platform software/hardware integration, site segmentation, offline operation and recovery process on a small, reproducible reference site.

assumptions.workload_notes: Assumptions for the lab profile only. Actual throughput, concurrency, coverage, power and storage capacity must be measured on the exact configured hardware.

design_principles: Default deny between security zones; explicitly allow only documented flows.
No public inbound management services; remote administration only through an approved authenticated path.
Central management loss must not prevent safe local operation, boot or recovery.
Keep the out-of-band recovery path independent of the production LAN; a management VLAN on the same switch is not physical independence.
Backups are separate from primary storage, encrypted, and restore-tested; a mirror alone is not a backup.
A component's H0 candidate status or a market listing never implies sourcing, product qualification or authorization.
Use local controller/management mode for the lab; cloud access is disabled unless explicitly assessed and authorized.

management_plane.restriction: Management services are reachable only from the privileged-admin zone or physically controlled local console. Any server BMC/iDRAC uses a dedicated isolated interface where available.
management_plane.recovery_limit: The initial profile has no separately qualified OOB switch/console server. A VLAN on the same switch is not an independent failure domain; physical console recovery remains mandatory.

segments.name: Network and server management
segments.purpose: Switch, AP, router management and BMC only; allowlisted time/update flows as required.

segments.name: Privileged administration
segments.purpose: Managed admin workstation and approved administrative tools; MFA and host/device controls required.

segments.name: Staff endpoints
segments.purpose: Ordinary user clients; no direct access to management services.

segments.name: Local services
segments.purpose: Directory/identity adapters, DNS/NTP if hosted, applications, logs and internal services; explicitly allowlisted outbound updates only.

segments.name: Guest Wi-Fi
segments.purpose: Internet-only access; block site-private IPv4, internal IPv6 prefixes and all management networks.

segments.name: IoT and printers
segments.purpose: Permit only named service destinations, DHCP/DNS/NTP and approved updates.

segments.name: Backup target
segments.purpose: Backup ingress only during allowed windows; separate credentials and retention controls; no ordinary workstation access.

segments.name: Lab/quarantine
segments.purpose: Untrusted devices and test workloads; no route to management, staff or production service zones.

limits: Deny all site-private IPv4 prefixes and internal IPv6 prefixes
required_flow_contracts.description: Deny all internal prefixes and inter-VLAN destinations, including IPv6.
Only the privileged admin zone may initiate supported management protocols.
No lateral access to staff, admin, management or backup.
Backup target is not a general-purpose share and cannot be modified by ordinary endpoint credentials.
No route from quarantine to management, staff or server zones.

components.function: Stateful edge router/firewall for VLAN, WAN, DNS/DHCP and optional VPN integration tests
components.candidate_use: Lab evaluation only; not a substitute for a government procurement's contract-backed next-generation firewall and support obligations.
blockers: Pin exact board revision/lot and firmware release.
Measure firewall throughput with actual ACL/VPN features and realistic packet sizes.
Validate secure update, fail-safe reset and restore.
If used for an operational agency profile, compare against a vendor-supported NGFW with required licensing, support SLA and tender eligibility.

components.function: Managed access switch with PoE for the access point and VLAN segmentation
components.model_candidate: Compare exact-current TP-Link Omada SG2210MP and TL-SG3210XHP-M2 V1 quotations; select only after model/firmware/lifecycle and VLAN test evidence.
minimum_requirements: DHCP snooping and management access controls
blockers: Get South African supplier quotes for both exact hardware revisions, firmware branch, warranty, stock and end-of-support dates.
Do not order an unspecified TL-SG2210MP listing; older revision names may refer to an EOL model.
Validate local management/controller mode, cloud dependency, 802.1X/RADIUS, VLAN ACL behavior, DHCP controls and IPv4/IPv6 segmentation on the exact selected hardware.
Compare PoE demand, uplink capacity, noise/thermal behavior, serviceability and total cost before choosing one.

components.function: Staff and guest Wi-Fi with separated SSIDs/VLANs
components.model_candidate: TP-Link Omada EAP650 indoor ceiling-mount Wi-Fi 6
minimum_requirements: WPA3 policy where supported by all relevant clients
local management with no mandatory cloud dependency
blockers: Pin hardware revision and firmware; validate WPA3 and 802.1X against the selected identity service.
Use local management/controller mode and test WAN/cloud outage.
Survey RF and confirm legal South African channel/power settings.

components.function: Local identity/service adapters, evidence/log collection, internal services and deployment control-plane test
components.model_candidate: Dell PowerEdge T160, quote configuration not selected
minimum_requirements: TPM 2.0 and supported firmware update process
32–64 GB ECC RAM target for pilot growth
two enterprise SSDs or boot/storage design with redundancy where supported
NixOS compatibility test for selected CPU/NIC/storage controller
blockers: Do not treat a 16 GB/single 2 TB HDD marketplace baseline as the recommended configuration.
Obtain a line-item quote with exact part numbers, TPM, ECC memory, disk/controller topology, power supply and support response time.
Isolate iDRAC on management network with no direct Internet exposure; test credentials, firmware and recovery.

components.function: Reproducible NixOS workstation profile for admin and ordinary users
components.model_candidate: Framework Laptop 13 AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series; commercial support and exact local SKU not confirmed
minimum_requirements: TPM 2.0 or equivalent platform trust evidence
signed boot chain per target deployment policy
NixOS hardware module and pinned kernel/firmware
blockers: Framework/NixOS docs require careful Secure Boot treatment; qualify the exact firmware with a maintained signed boot path such as the applicable Lanzaboote flow rather than turning Secure Boot off and forgetting it.
Verify custom-key enrollment, firmware updates, dbx handling and recovery on the exact unit.
Confirm South African procurement, warranty, import and replacement availability; keep a supported commercial endpoint alternative open.

components.function: Administrator and operator phishing-resistant authenticators, plus enrollment/revocation process
components.model_candidate: Evaluate YubiKey 5C NFC FIPS 140-3 as one authentication option; exact certificate scope, IdP compatibility and local supply still unverified.
minimum_requirements: Two separately stored authenticators per privileged operator, plus an enrollment/recovery procedure
Document FIDO2/WebAuthn, smart-card or customer-required certificate requirements
Validate required certificate/module status for the relevant jurisdiction
blockers: Determine the relying party and customer-required authenticator protocol/assurance profile before selecting hardware.
Verify exact model and certificate #5291 scope/status if a FIPS validated module is required.
Confirm South African delivery, warranty/replacements and identity-provider/browser compatibility.
Exercise enroll, sign-in, revoke, loss and emergency account recovery with two separate keys per privileged operator.

components.function: Independent encrypted backup target for server configuration, records and critical data
minimum_requirements: Separate failure domain from primary server
Restricted backup credentials and write scope
Periodic restore test with measured RPO/RTO
blockers: Select exact NAS/server, drives, controller and firmware.
A mirror or RAID alone is not a backup; define a separately protected offline/offsite copy.

components.function: Offline or otherwise separately protected recovery and backup copy
minimum_requirements: Encrypted, integrity-checked artifacts and restore media
Offline recovery instructions tested with no Internet
blockers: Choose media capacity, retention, recovery key custody and physical custodian.
Demonstrate restore from this medium in the no-network failure drill.

components.model_candidate: APC Easy UPS SMV1500AI or SMV1500AI-GR, 230 V; exact outlet SKU to select
minimum_requirements: Runtime sized from measured load and target shutdown/uptime
USB or network telemetry with maintained shutdown driver
blockers: Obtain written local quote and verify exact outlet/plug SKU, stock, warranty, support and replacement-battery price.
Measure total server/switch/AP load and choose runtime target before calculating battery runtime.
Verify and test USB/serial monitoring with NUT or the chosen shutdown daemon; capture exact driver/model compatibility.
Run mains-loss, low-battery, self-test-failure, graceful shutdown and recovery tests before the profile can pass.

components.function: Recovery path when WAN, normal LAN, central services or management plane fail
minimum_requirements: Physical console/recovery access for initial lab
Separate OOB network and console server for operational site
Recovery not dependent on central management, DNS or WAN
blockers: The first lab uses a local physical console, not a fully independent networked OOB plane.
Choose and test a separate OOB network/console design before operational agency deployment.

components.function: Operational-government firewall option with support contract when procurement requires it
minimum_requirements: Three-year or contract-required support and license
Documented software update and incident-response SLA
Bidder/vendor channel eligible under the actual tender
blockers: Not needed to exercise the lab's open-source gateway path; mandatory for some procurement profiles. Re-open this component when turning the lab architecture into a government operational offer.

components.function: Patch cables, labels and any required SFP/fibre link
minimum_requirements: CAT6 or better copper for gigabit/PoE runs within length limits
Correct SFP/SFP+ type and link budget where needed
Documented cable/link labels and tested port map
blockers: Measure run lengths and confirm exact switch hardware version and optics compatibility before ordering.

price_research.configuration_note: TP-Link EAP650 indoor ceiling-mount Wi-Fi 6 AP; marketplace comparison showed two sellers. Exact hardware revision and a written quote are still required.
Marketplace comparison of a Xeon E-2414, 16 GB ECC, 2 TB HDD baseline; seller/configuration/service variation is large and this is not the target build.
Manufacturer product page showed ZAR 8,630 excluding VAT and subject to change on 2026-10-10. This is an indicative price, not a supplier quote; exact outlet SKU and local stock need confirmation.

pricing_snapshot.explanation: The partial subtotal only sums the two observed marketplace price ranges above for one AP and one server; it is not a full BOM estimate, quote, approval to buy, or procurement budget. Switch pricing is deliberately omitted because live listings may omit an EOL/ambiguous hardware version. The UPS's manufacturer price is recorded as an indicative candidate but excluded from the partial subtotal until the unit/outlet SKU and supplier quote are pinned.

acceptance_gates.evidence_expected: Exact-head schema/validator output binds profile to catalogue commit; unknown/duplicate catalogue references fail.
Quotes identify exact models/hardware revisions, warranties, support end dates, lead times and local service route.
Firmware/software bill of materials, signature/update/recovery paths, licenses and source revisions captured.
Exact endpoint/server Secure Boot, TPM/measured-boot and full-disk-encryption tests, including rollback/recovery.
Physical-device tests prove VLAN mapping, default deny, guest isolation, IPv4/IPv6 rules and allowed flows.
Admin enrollment/MFA, separate credentials, audit, controller-locality and management-plane isolation tested.
Signed updates, restore and safe operation without WAN/central service tested.
Separate backup media, recovery keys, restore point and measured RPO/RTO validated.
Mains loss, UPS runtime/shutdown, PoE limit, disk failure and interrupted update/reboot tested.
Measured throughput, CPU/memory, Wi-Fi coverage, log retention, alerting and capacity margins captured.
Local spares, replacement procedures, delivery/warranty, support path and obsolescence evidence recorded.
Named customer/security authority requirements, formal assessment and written authorization. Not part of this non-production lab profile.

explicit_non_claims: This reference profile is not production-qualified or deployment-authorized.
No listed candidate has passed hardware-in-the-loop or exact SKU validation through this profile.
No inventory price is a formal supplier quotation.
The profile is not a substitute for a specific South African agency tender pack, security policy or lawful authorization.
The OpenWrt One lab candidate is not automatically a contract-backed next-generation firewall.
The initial management VLAN is not a fully independent out-of-band network.
